facts.fact: 惊醒：闻吼睁眼——咳出凝结血块、指尖只摸到灰烬（vetiver+bonemeal 恶臭）——「I died.」——声音「too high and too strange」。
死亡记忆逐层回放：斧弧/肋断/肺灌/心衰——「a library of sense memory kept in purposeful disorder」；胸口皮肤平滑完好、心跳如常；身周一圈黑玫瑰；血中混红花瓣。
死亡的知识与体验：Vakara 皆通死亡之感的种类——但 none of it compared to their application in her own body——钩在体内如终结论的钩。
facts.anchor: A Vakara understood the sensation of dying.

facts.fact: 父亲尸体：临床清单（断肋/红组织黄脂/肺动脉裂/肋间肌断）——「All these things made up a body. / All these things made up her father.」
facts.anchor: All these things made up her father.

facts.fact: 复活失败：torus 搜魂——「there was no Rath Vakara」——父亲早知她会尝试、最后一举正是阻止她复活——「Not trusting her even in death」。
facts.anchor: He had already fled to the void, beyond her reach.

facts.fact: 玛丽格菊毯：父亲的血生成橙菊花毯缠发缝合致命伤——撕一茎生两茎——「You can't take him」；她也未能执行「Burn the dead」之令（不能让最后一眼停在恐惧里）。
facts.anchor: she sobbed between bloody fistfuls of petals

facts.fact: 姐妹：Saya 到场——「Don't look. Don't look.」——相拥成 bereft tide 摇晃——「no bigger loss than this: of daughters who hadn't gotten the chance to say goodbye」。
收束：东方光柱=传送门（Dante 办到了）；「You have to protect him until this is over」；对花冢说迟到的「I love you」——「the agony of surviving」——「spared for a reason」——追门而去。
facts.anchor: she had been spared for a reason.
